name: Renewal Watch
office_task: Keep our licences, insurances and site services on a calendar worked out from each state's rules, file the certificates when they come in, and put anything late in front of a named person.
systems_of_record: the business's obligation register (its compliance calendar, rule set and the document store certificates are filed in)

emits.write: a certificate, policy schedule or service report from an email, filed as evidence of completion on the obligation it names by obligation id; a message with no obligation id is never matched by name and is raised instead
emits.readback: the obligation is read back by its id and must return the same evidence reference (the message_id and attachment) and a completion date; if it does not, nothing was filed and renewal.evidence_not_read_back is raised

emits.write: an exception on the obligation naming the person who owns it: an unknown anchor date, no rule in force, a past date no retained rule version explains, a completion claimed without a document, a dated refusal, a breach, a drafted booking or renewal awaiting a named release, a release with no named person, silence past the next chase date, or an email with no obligation id
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the obligation id, the reason and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops
